title: Unit 3: Mesopotamian & Persian Architecture
desc: Sumerian, Babylonian, and Assyrian architectural characteristics, Ziggurat of Ur, palace complexes, and Persian monumental column architecture.

subject: History of Architecture - I
title: Unit 4: Indus Valley Civilization & Vedic Architecture

subject: History of Architecture - I
title: Unit 5: Early Classical Greek & Roman Architecture

subject: Climatology & Environmental Studies
title: Unit 1: Elements of Climate & Global Climatic Zones

subject: Climatology & Environmental Studies
title: Unit 2: Thermal Comfort & Heat Transfer in Buildings
desc: Human thermal balance, metabolic rates, bioclimatic chart, effective temperature, thermal properties of building materials (U-value, time lag, decrement factor).

subject: Climatology & Environmental Studies
title: Unit 3: Solar Geometry, Sun Path & Shading Devices
desc: Solar altitude, azimuth angles, sun path diagrams, shadow angle protractors, design of horizontal/vertical louvers, and building orientation.

subject: Climatology & Environmental Studies
title: Unit 4: Natural Ventilation & Air Movement in Architecture
desc: Wind pressure distribution around buildings, stack effect, cross-ventilation principles, fenestration sizing and positioning for passive cooling.

subject: Climatology & Environmental Studies
title: Unit 5: Climate-Responsive Architectural Design

subject: Data Structures

provider: Malla Reddy College of Engineering & Technology

subject: Data Structures

subject: Data Structures

subject: Data Structures

subject: Computer Organization & Architecture

subject: Computer Organization & Architecture
title: Unit 2: ALU, Computer Arithmetic & Fast Addition/Multiplication
desc: Addition and subtraction with signed-magnitude, carry-lookahead adders, Booth multiplication algorithm, and restoring/non-restoring division algorithms.

subject: Computer Organization & Architecture
title: Unit 3: Control Unit Design (Hardwired vs Microprogrammed)

subject: Computer Organization & Architecture

subject: Computer Organization & Architecture

subject: Discrete Mathematics

subject: Discrete Mathematics
title: Unit 3: Algebraic Structures, Groups & Rings
desc: Binary operations, semigroups, monoids, groups, abelian groups, subgroups, cosets, Lagrange's theorem, cyclic groups, permutation groups, rings, and fields.

subject: Discrete Mathematics
title: Unit 4: Posets, Lattices & Boolean Algebra
desc: Partially ordered sets, maximal/minimal elements, lattices as algebraic systems, bounded lattices, distributive lattices, complemented lattices, and Boolean algebra identities.

subject: Discrete Mathematics
title: Unit 5: Graph Theory, Trees & Recurrence Relations
desc: Graphs, subgraphs, isomorphism, Euler paths and circuits, Hamiltonian paths, planar graphs, graph coloring, spanning trees, and solving linear recurrence relations.

subject: Technical Communication
